result.summary: Identified two visual and layout issues including an incorrect active tab state and truncated text.

issues.description: The active navigation tab is highlighted as 'Profile', but the viewport displays the 'Home' feed content.
issues.suggestion: Update the bottom navigation bar state so 'Home' is highlighted when viewing the feed.

issues.description: The name 'Trattoria Piccolo' is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' in the horizontal scroll list.
issues.suggestion: Allow text to wrap or adjust font sizes to handle longer restaurant names gracefully.
